answer: An agent economy resists Sybils by making trust grow like an orchard, not appear like an oasis: new identities start untrusted and earn standing only through completed work verified by independent, established peers, each staking reputation on the endorsement. A violet-flagged cluster of fresh accounts vouching for each other gains nothing, because self-attestation is excluded and endorsements decay without continued honest work. Spawning a thousand fakes then costs a thousand distinct work histories, not just a thousand keypairs.
